slug: 2024-08-15 Mauritania Launches Digital ID for e-Services, Built on TECH5 Platform (Houwiyeti)

systems.platform: TECH5 face-biometric components (T5-OmniMatch, T5-AirSnap, T5-LDS, T5-IDencode); SmartMS back end and identity provider
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition, Innovation and Public Sector Modernisation (MTNIMA), with UNDP
systems.tiers: digital identity app with selfie-based verification giving access to government e-services; pilot contract June 2022, demonstrated March 2023, concluded October 2023

note: A digital identity application for logging in to e-services; nothing on registering births or deaths.
